$comment: Why this case is in the corpus: the evaluation job runs the root install, which the evaluations folder's own package.json makes unnecessary and which fails in a repository with no root manifest.
Every other element is the capture's, so the result is that one deviation.
derivation: The file parses and lints clean and every element is present, but the evaluation job runs a root npm ci, which the scorer reports as a rule violation.

ruleViolations: root-install: npm ci in job evaluation-pr, which runs an evaluation check
